title: FieldCatalogue
description:
`test-vectors/core/fields.json`: the field catalogue of 03-api-model.md §9.1 for the C++
and binding runners, generated by `cargo xtask fields --write` (API-082, M2 plan D2).

fields.description:
Every entry, in code order from 1. The codes of one block run without a gap; the blocks
that are not full leave gaps between them (03-api-model.md §9.1).

source.description: Where the entries come from; the file is never edited by hand.

FieldEntry.description: One entry of the field catalogue (03-api-model.md §9.1, API-082).

code.description: The field code; never 0, which means "no field" in the C ABI.

kind.description: Whether the code names a Blue Book field or a parameter.

oneOf.description: A field of a data unit defined by a Blue Book.
A managed parameter, configuration value, argument, or length the caller passes.
